title: CloudDash API: Managing Alerts
content:
You can programmatically create, update, delete, and list alerts using the CloudDash Alerts API. This is ideal for managing monitoring configurations as code (e.g., via Terraform).

## Listing Alerts

`GET https://api.clouddash.io/v1/alerts`

Returns a list of all configured alerts in your workspace.

## Creating an Alert

`POST https://api.clouddash.io/v1/alerts`

Create a new alert by defining the metric, threshold, and notification channels.

### Example Request (cURL)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.clouddash.io/v1/alerts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer cd_live_your_key_here" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "High API Latency",
    "description": "Triggers when API latency exceeds 500ms for 5 minutes",
    "metric_namespace": "AWS/ApiGateway",
    "metric_name": "Latency",
    "stat": "Average",
    "period": 300,
    "evaluation_periods": 1,
    "threshold": 500.0,
    "comparison_operator": "GreaterThanThreshold",
    "severity": "high",
    "notification_channels": ["slack-channel-id", "email-id"]
  }'
```

### Parameters

- `comparison_operator`: Must be one of `GreaterThanThreshold`, `LessThanThreshold`, `GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold`, `LessThanOrEqualToThreshold`.
- `evaluation_periods`: The number of consecutive periods the metric must breach the threshold before the alert fires (e.g., 3 periods of 60 seconds = 3 minutes sustained).
- `notification_channels`: Array of channel IDs (obtainable via `GET /v1/notifications/channels`).

## Updating an Alert

`PUT https://api.clouddash.io/v1/alerts/{alert_id}`

The payload is the same as the POST request. The entire alert configuration will be replaced by the new payload.

## Muting an Alert

`POST https://api.clouddash.io/v1/alerts/{alert_id}/mute`

Temporarily suppress notifications for an alert (useful during deployments or maintenance windows).

```json
{
  "duration_minutes": 120
}
```

To unmute, call `POST /v1/alerts/{alert_id}/unmute`.
